Case study 03

From unstructured information to analyzable data

Project developed in R combining language processing, regular expressions, structured information extraction, and web scraping. The workflow demonstrates how to transform text and web content into data structures that can be analyzed and visualized.

R rvest tm wordcloud stringr ggplot2
Text Mining Corpus cleaning, term-document matrix, and vocabulary comparison across texts.
Scraping Extracción con rvest de 381 records desde una tabla web de Wikipedia y transformación de variables.
Visualization Comparison cloud, commonality cloud, yearly bar charts, and temporal dispersion of reviews.
Findings and techniques demonstrated Comparative clouds distinguish characteristic and shared vocabulary between “The Fellowship of the Ring” and “The Two Towers.” Scraping converts HTML tables into a structured dataset, while regular expressions extract names, phone numbers, emails, dates, and numeric formats from unstructured text.

About

Mathematics, statistics, and data.

A combination of quantitative training, educational experience, and developing expertise in data analytics and Business Intelligence.

Professional profile

I am M. Sc. Geiner Bejarano Barrantes, a data analyst with a strong foundation in mathematics, statistics, and industrial engineering. My purpose is to turn complex and abstract data into clear, understandable, and useful information for decision-making.

My experience as a Mathematics teacher complements my technical profile with an especially valuable data analytics skill: understanding complex problems, structuring them, and communicating their results clearly and effectively. This combination of quantitative thinking, analytical judgment, and communication allows me to go beyond the numbers to identify patterns, build visualizations, and turn findings into meaningful business information.

Across my projects, I apply Python, SQL Server, R, Power BI, DAX and statistical techniques to develop workflows that span data preparation and exploration through analysis, visualization, and communication.

It is not just about analyzing data. It is about turning data into information people can understand and use to make better decisions. Data → comprensión → decisiones.
